milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find lilac' is an observation/locate task — the player must navigate near the lilac flower and face toward it, confirming visual discovery. The lilac is at spawn-relative [5, 1, 4] (upper half of the two-block-tall flower). A max_distance of 8 blocks and facing_tolerance of 60° ensures the player has intentionally approached and is looking at the lilac rather than just wandering nearby.
